description: Restore old photos with AI MendPhoto is an online AI photo restoration tool for repairing faded, scratched, creased, noisy, or blurry photographs while keeping familiar faces and original details recognizable. Key features - Repairs fading, scratches, dust, creases, noise, and blur - Preserves faces, expressions, clothing, and composition - Supports JPG, PNG, and WebP files up to 15 MB - Provides before-and-after comparison - Generates a downloadable 1K result - Works directly in your browser Me
